newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Evans says Australia can grow above 3.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Evans says Australia can grow above 3.5 pct.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Thursday that the Australian economy could grow considerably faster than 3.5 percent.
"I do believe that we can grow at a considerably faster rate than three-and-a-half percent, in fact I know we can," Evans told a business economists.
The government has forecast gross domestic product to rise 3.75 percent through the year to June 30, 1998 from an estimated 3.25 percent in 1996/97.
